name: Madagascar
about: Dry season Apr–Nov is far easier for lemur trekking and road travel; cyclone risk peaks Jan–Mar with some areas cut off.
overview: Lemurs found nowhere else on Earth, otherworldly baobab avenues, and rainforest found nowhere else in the world.
costOverview: One of the most affordable destinations in this list — a zebu skewer from a street stall costs just a few dollars, and even a guided lemur park walk is cheap by international standards.
